description: The older-cyclist research team publishes a survey of 5,096 respondents aged at least fifty in the United States and Canada. Responses collected from August 2021 through July 2022 cover bicycle type, riding frequency and distance, night riding, trip purposes, and factors that encourage or discourage cycling. Zenodo provides the named survey for free under CC BY 4.0. These behavioural inputs can calibrate cycling-demand or route-choice simulations and test accessibility assumptions in active-mobility planning. The respondents are older cyclists, not a random population sample, and the deposit metadata does not establish detailed spatial resolution or respondent weighting. Those limits matter when transferring rates to individual cities. Individual responses were not inspected. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
